title: PaymentCaptured
description: A card payment was settled: what the shipper owed for a completed haul, or for cancelling one late, was taken from the card. `shortfall` is what the card did not give and the shipper now owes.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payment_id.description: The card payment of the load.

load_id.description: The load the payment is for.

authorized.description: What stands blocked on the card for the load after this event, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

carrier_org_id.description: The carrier organization of the haul.

purpose.title: PaymentPurpose
purpose.description: `haul`: a completed haul was charged; `cancel_fee`: the fee of a late cancellation.

amount.description: What was taken from the card, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

commission.description: The platform's commission on the haul, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today); 0 for a cancellation fee. The carrier is credited `amount` less the part of it the card covered.

shortfall.description: What the card was asked for and did not give, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).
